title: The Cornerstone, Lower Kilmacud Road, Stillorgan, Co. Dublin
seoTitle: The Cornerstone, Lower Kilmacud Road, Stillorgan, Co. Dublin

prs.tagLine: Discover your perfect lifestyle in the heart of a vibrant village.

description:
The Cornerstone is a prestigious new residential development in the dynamic heart of Stillorgan Village - an area with your lifestyle in mind. With the well-known Stillorgan Village Shopping Centre adjacent to the scheme, it has a range of amenities from department stores and boutiques to cafés and restaurants.  
Getting to The Cornerstone couldn't be easier. We are right on the N11 with a Quality Bus Corridor which means you can be in the City Centre in less than 30 minutes. Aircoach provides a direct link to Dublin Airport via the city centre. There is ample basement parking and a place to park your bike or E Bike or E-Scooter. Blackrock Village, Dun Laoghaire seafront and Dundrum Town Centre are all less than 20-minute drive
features: Fully-integrated kitchen units with high quality appliances
Dedicated on-site Concierge and Management Team
Newly-furnished apartments with high quality contemporary furniture and fittings by MJF Interiors
Modern resident amenities including Gym, Lounge areas, Communal kitchen, Large games & cinema room, Business centre, Children's playroom & playground
Basement parking available including EV parking spaces
Secure bicycle parking with facility to service bikes
